items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: We did some things behind Etta Jones, for RCA Victor.

ctx.x: That was after the Cafe Society job ended?

No, we were doing some dates when I was there. We did some things behind Etta Jones, for RCA Victor. Then I did some things with Trummy Young which John Levy did before he became George Shearing's manager and Jimmy Jones and Ray Nance. I don't know what ever happened to them. Bob Thiele produced that date. I don't know what ever happened to those records. I never heard anything about that. That was a great date. Jimmy Jones made the arrangements. Trummy sang and Ray Nance played. It was good. I would like to find…
